physical_contract.legacy_maxwell_policy: The historical EOS390 matrix token 'maxwell' identifies the project-defined smooth NPPHB procedure for historical reproduction only; it is not a sharp first-order transition and has Delta n_B=0. Preserve its native implementation under the explicit legacy kernel name legacy_npphb and never classify it as FIRST_ORDER_SHARP. Keep an ambiguous public bare 'maxwell' alias fail-closed. compose_contract.supported_scope: Default production surface remains a selected cold T=0 EOS slice. composition.serialization: Y_I = Y_h/Abar when Abar>0; otherwise no nuclear-group quadruple
composition.phase_metadata: Iphase is an integer categorical label whose physical meaning is model/provider-specific. Never interpret a numeric ID as a universal phase name.
composition.phase_only_rows: When no abundance values exist but Iphase metadata must be retained, CompOSE v3.01 permits Npairs=0 and Nquad=0. Keep composition_file_present separate from composition_available.

composition.no_fabrication: Never fabricate particle fractions, Abar, Zbar, or Y_I when source composition is absent. For APR_APR and BBB_BHF2, only create model-derived beta-equilibrium composition through the explicitly ported and provenance-labelled legacy literature solver.

current_adjudication.reference: CompOSE Reference Manual v3.01 (2022), arXiv:2203.03209, Sec. 4.2.3, Eqs. (4.20)-(4.22)
current_adjudication.standard_field: YI is the combined group number fraction; Xh=Abar*YI is the group baryon fraction. Iphase is provider-defined.
current_adjudication.source_finding: Across 13 raw crust eos.compo files (4,172 rows), Iphase=0 raw group values are 1.0 and closure-compatible with Xh rather than standard YI. Iphase=7 raw group values are compatible with neither YI nor Xh using the available n/p/e/mu fractions. The v3.2 normalizer ignores raw group values, derives Yh from n/p closure plus charge neutrality, and writes YI=Yh/Abar; small normalized residuals are therefore reconstructed, not independent source validation.
current_adjudication.decision: Retain raw fields and Iphase categories unchanged. Keep production composition blocked pending provider-authored semantics or independently validated microscopic source.

nadd.supported_values: all integer Nadd >= 0 in native CompOSE I/O (M10 phase 2)
nadd.policy: Nadd counts provider-defined eos.thermo extension columns. The full extra-column tensor is preserved by the generalized I/O path. Existing reconstruction/solver consumers may retain narrower Nadd limits and must reject unsupported layouts rather than silently discard columns. Categorical q_extra values, including pasta-geometry indicators, are not continuous interpolation variables.
nadd.source_observation: SPG_M1 was observed with Nadd=0; GPPVA_FSU2H was observed with Nadd=1; synthetic M10 tests cover Nadd=2 and Nadd=3 round-trips.

q3_convention.Il_1: Q3+1 maps to Euler baryon chemical potential divided by m_n on the supported beta-equilibrium branch with Q5 approximately zero.
q3_convention.Il_0: Recover Euler mu_B by adding Yq*mu_q to the stored Q3-derived potential: mu_Euler = (Q3+1)*m_n + Yq*Q4*m_n.
q3_convention.tolerances: Keep the source/reconstruction algebraic tolerance distinct from the sharp-Maxwell kernel Euler consistency tolerance.

phase_ontology.authority: Thermodynamic phase classification is independent of interpolation method, EOS parametrization, CompOSE Iphase integer, and source-provider phase labels.

classifications.criterion: At common coexistence (P_t,mu_t), n_plus>n_minus and epsilon_plus>epsilon_minus, with Delta epsilon=mu_t*Delta n_B for one conserved baryon charge and the declared neutrality condition.
classifications.note: Maxwell means local electric neutrality in each phase here; global-neutrality mixed phases are Gibbs-like and require an independent charge chemical potential and volume fraction.

classifications.criterion: The relevant thermodynamic potential and first derivatives remain continuous while a higher derivative/susceptibility or order-parameter derivative has a reproducible nonanalyticity.
classifications.note: A continuous n_B or zero energy jump alone does not prove second order.

classifications.criterion: No thermodynamic nonanalyticity is established; the EOS and relevant derivatives remain smooth over a resolved finite-density interval.
classifications.note: A broad or narrow softening peak is not by itself proof of a phase transition.

classifications.criterion: Two or more conserved charges with global neutrality and a varying phase fraction over a finite interval.
required_evidence: P(mu_B,mu_Q) or equivalent multicharge thermodynamic surface

classifications.criterion: A discontinuity, kink, or phase label is present but thermodynamic evidence is insufficient to classify the transition.
required_evidence: preserve raw samples and categorical phase metadata

inference_guards: Never infer transition order from method names such as CSS, Maxwell, cubic, or quintic.
Never infer physical phase identity from numeric Iphase values without provider-local provenance.
Never infer second-order or crossover from Delta epsilon=0 alone.
Never classify a sharp jump as Maxwell until P and mu_B continuity and the first-law jump identity pass.
A crust-to-medium or medium-to-core interface may carry a density jump; interface location does not force continuity.
Do not smooth interpolation stencils across declared Iphase or physical interface boundaries.

css_segment_contract.source: Alford, Han & Prakash (2013), arXiv:1302.4732, PRD 88, 083013; Alford et al. (2015), arXiv:1501.07902, PRD 92, 083002.
acceptance: At P=P_t, high-side epsilon,n,mu recover the declared transition state.
Delta epsilon=mu_t*(n_high_transition-n_low) within floating-point tolerance.
For positive Delta epsilon, classify sharp first-order interface.
For Delta epsilon=0, report CONTINUOUS_UNCLASSIFIED; never infer second-order or crossover.
For every high-side sample, dP/depsilon=cs2 and d epsilon/d n_B=mu_B.
Reject cs2<=0, cs2>1, negative Delta epsilon, nonfinite inputs, and pressure samples below P_t.
This branch primitive is not yet a CompOSE writer, common matcher, TOV/Love/Cowling integration, or 390 runner.

legacy_method_semantics.actual_algorithm: smooth Hermite pressure bridge with knots u={0,0.22,0.78,1}, plateau offset 0.015*(P2-P1), 64-point Gauss-Legendre endpoint integral root and 16-point partial integrals
legacy_method_semantics.observed_physics: continuous density, no latent heat, no exact common-pressure/common-mu coexistence; Delta n_B=0
legacy_method_semantics.research_note: Literature has distinct finite-width P(mu_B) replacement/interpolation schemes around a Maxwell crossing, including parabolic replacement interpolation and the Mixing Interpolation Method (MIM). The historical NPPHB parameterization is not identified as the same published construction. Preserve it only as an immutable legacy reference; exclude it from physical Maxwell and new production method naming.
legacy_method_semantics.quadrature_audit: The historical path uses a 64-point whole-interval Gauss-Legendre integral for the plateau root and 16-point whole-interval partial integrals for interior F(u). The cubic-Hermite pressure spline has internal knots at u=0.22 and u=0.78, but the partial quadrature does not split at those knots. A separate 2026-11-13 scratch audit identifies a partial-integral accuracy defect; preserve this route as legacy parity only until knot-split/adaptive or analytic quadrature is independently validated. Endpoint-only first-law residual does not certify the interior F(u) profile.

manual.row_schema: iT inb iYq Iphase Npairs (particle_id,Y_i)* Nquad (group_id,Aav,Zav,YI)*

definitions.empty: Npairs=0 and Nquad=0 is legal for phase-only metadata

established.schema: The sampled records satisfy the official 18-token row grammar and (iT,inb,iYq) keys align row-by-row with eos.thermo.
established.parser_hypothesis: The prior parser-width/indexing hypothesis is rejected for the sampled sources.
established.nadd: Nadd counts separate eos.thermo extension columns. In sampled GPPVA_FSU2H, q_extra is a categorical pasta-geometry value and is not Iphase.

numerical_findings.outer_crust: Representative Aav=56,Zav=26 rows have final tuple value=1, Ye=26/56, Yn=Yp=Ymu=0. Treating final value as standard YI gives Xh=56, violating baryon normalization. Interpreting it as Xh=1 is only a diagnostic hypothesis, not a documented convention.
numerical_findings.inner_crust: In sampled SPG_M1/GPPVA_FSU2H rows, final value equals Ye+Ymu to printed precision. SPG_M1 C3- and C4-implied cluster baryon fractions disagree in all 148 Iphase=7 rows; C6B records C3-implied range 0.096..0.543 versus C4-implied 1.
rejected_maps: Yh=last_value: outer rows only; fails SPG inner rows
Yh=1: diagnostic only, undocumented, and fails SPG inner charge closure

questions_for_providers: Define the fourth tuple value separately for Iphase=0 and Iphase=7.
Are Aav/Zav representative cluster/group quantities or transformed whole-cell quantities?
Why does the final tuple value equal Ye+Ymu in inspected inner-crust rows?
Where is free-neutron gas represented in SPG inner crust if Yn=0?
Are Yn=Yp=0 intended zeros or missing/unexported abundances?
stop_rules: Do not infer the final value to mean YI, Xh, Ye, gas fraction, or another aggregate.
Do not relax C3/C4, drop composition, or fabricate Yn/Yp.
Do not interpolate Iphase or categorical Nadd values.
Block SPG/GPPVA composition production admission until written provider semantics and independent closure exist.

Mixed source coverage yields row-level CHECKED/PARTIAL/NOT_AVAILABLE/FAIL receipts.

mutation_gates.name: Branch and authority lock
mutation_gates.rule: Read repository, branch, HEAD, tree SHA, worktree status and base ref. Abort if branch or expected parent differs.

mutation_gates.name: Immutable source lock
mutation_gates.rule: Hash original raw inputs, historical outputs, model datasheets and code references before execution. Never overwrite or normalize in place.

mutation_gates.name: Read-before-edit and TDD
mutation_gates.rule: Read complete target module, callers, tests and DAG nodes. Add a failing regression test before the minimal implementation.

mutation_gates.name: Physics claim gate
mutation_gates.rule: For every numerical kernel record equations, units, assumptions, boundary/initial conditions, interpolation domain and forbidden extrapolation. Cite a primary source or label the result DERIVED.

mutation_gates.name: Build and static checks
mutation_gates.rule: Compile with explicit compiler/version/flags; run targeted tests, full Python frontend and pipeline tests, native analytic tests, lint/static checks and checksum verification.

mutation_gates.name: Independent numerical validation
mutation_gates.rule: Compare against analytic fixtures, independent derivations or read-only legacy oracles. Preserve failures; never loosen tolerances merely to pass.

mutation_gates.name: Output isolation
mutation_gates.rule: Write each attempt into a new immutable attempt directory. Raw inputs and v3.2 outputs are read-only.

mutation_gates.name: Readback and receipt
mutation_gates.rule: Read every generated CompOSE table with the native reader, verify all row keys/fields/closure and create per-task JSON receipts and SHA-256.

mutation_gates.name: Git mutation lease
mutation_gates.rule: Commit only to cloud/eos390-fortran-unification-v1. Re-read branch head and use expected_sha on ref updates. No force push and no main mutation.

mutation_gates.name: Publish gate
mutation_gates.rule: Publish only after the full 390 manifest, all readbacks, failure catalogue, source hashes and validation report are complete. Preserve historical paths.

mutation_gates.name: End-of-run audit
mutation_gates.rule: Record PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/NOT_RUN for each DAG node; compare input/output hashes; produce a handoff with exact next action.
